scoring_justification: The headline core energies are the product of a computationally heavy MD relaxation and linear fitting pipeline; recomputing them from raw atomic coordinates or energy-radius tables is infeasible within the verifier sandbox. A direct comparison of the reported Ec values to the published gold is the appropriate scoring level.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold core energies (eV) for the four-atom, five/seven-atom, and eight-atom dislocation cores.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table III: Ec values – four-atom 0.92 eV, five/seven-atom 1.02 eV, eight-atom 1.18 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the published table; numerical values are unchanged.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the authors' own computed core energies reported in the paper; they constitute the authoritative reference for reproduction.

outputs.description: The agent's computed core energies (Ec) for the three a-edge dislocation core configurations and the identification of the most stable core.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies the computed core energies and most stable core against the paper-reported values.
